title: Help & Support
subtitle: Get help with using MyJudicial
contactSubtitle: Our support team is available 24/7 to help you.
faq1q: How do I verify my account?
faq1a: Go to the Verification page under Account settings. Upload your government-issued ID and bar association license. Our team will review and approve within 2-3 business days.
faq2a: You can withdraw your earnings anytime from the Earnings page. Withdrawals are processed within 1-2 business days and sent to your registered mobile money or bank account.
faq3q: How do I set my availability?
faq3a: Navigate to the Availability page in your dashboard. You can set your working hours, break times, and block off dates. Clients will only see available slots.
